The contribution aims to measure levels of social cohesion and reconciliation in Liberia, accoridng to the Social Cohesion and Reconciliation Index (SCORE) methodology. The SCORE measure is carried out by Centre for Sustainable Peace and Democratic Development (SeeD), the Liberia Peacebuilding Office (PBO) and UNDP. This is the fourth wave of SCORE in Liberia and will contribute to understanding the progress for peace and social cohesion in the country since the first measure in 2016.
